page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full width: title lines at top, then a central engraving with a banner, then the imprint lines below. No running head, no page number.

main_text.l: [engraving: vase with flowers between cypress trees, banner reading COELO IRRORANT]

page.notes: Title page in red and black. The engraving is described above, not transcribed as text. The banner reads "COELO IRRORANT" as far as legible. The imprint line "MDCXCVI" is printed in the old reversed-C form and is given here as a Roman numeral. The word "THEOLOGIÆ" in the red line is set in roman capitals, and "CORPORIS THEOLOGIÆ" is in italic capitals.
